Princess of Wales opens up about cancer
Issued on:
Share
A new documentary titled Heal follows Britain's Princess Catherine as she navigates life since her cancer diagnosis in 2024. The film tracks the 44-year-old as she attempts to climb the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales within 24 hours. In the trailer, she reflects on healing as a journey. Ophelie Jacobson reports.
